text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I can't seem to feel any better. In
times
like this...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru, are you heeere? You must
be here
somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! How come you look so
different?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Whenever I feel down, she can
always
cheer me up with a fortune
reading.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Receiving a good fortune makes me
happy. And even when it's a bad result...
having a good cry helps to clear my
mind. Do you feel the same way,
Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm... not really here for a fortune.
I don't know,
talking to Fukukitaru makes me
feel better. That's
all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like it's the same for you. Good
fortune
or bad, you still leave feeling
better.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You're right. It's not about the
result. Which
means...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru just has a special touch.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She's good at helping you forget
your
worries.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Then... Do you think we should tell her?
That we
don't really care about the
fortune telling, we just
want to talk?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I think... it's better we don't.
That would
probably
make her feel bad.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh... that's true. To her,
fortunes are her
calling.
It's like her identity.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Then let's keep this our secret! Fukukitaru's happiness is our happiness too!
